name: tater-tot-brain-gym
description: A homeschool retention training app for the Tater Tot Academy

scripts.db:backup: mkdir -p backups && cp apps/api/prisma/dev.db backups/dev-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).db && echo 'Backup created in backups/'
scripts.prod:stop: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tatertot.braingym.plist 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:4000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.prod:status: launchctl list | grep com.tatertot.braingym || echo 'not loaded'
scripts.prod:deploy: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @ttbg/api exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm prod:restart
